title: Dinner is at Grandma's
instructions: Babası Nina'ya kısa bir mesaj bırakıyor. Değişen plana dikkat et.

script.speaker: dad
script.text: Hi Nina, it's Dad. We aren't eating at home tonight.

script.speaker: dad
script.text: We're having dinner at Grandma's house at seven.

script.speaker: dad
script.text: Can you buy some flowers for her on your way home?

script.speaker: dad
script.text: I'll pick you up at half past six.

questions.prompt: Where are they having dinner tonight?
questions.feedback: Bu akşam evde değil, büyükannenin evinde yiyecekler.
questions.evidence: We're having dinner at Grandma's house at seven.

questions.feedback: Eve gelirken büyükanne için çiçek (flowers) almalı.
questions.evidence: Can you buy some flowers for her

questions.prompt: What time will Dad pick Nina up?
questions.feedback: Babası onu altı buçukta (half past six) alacak; yemek yedide.
questions.evidence: I'll pick you up at half past six.
